text.text_excerpt: Cajun Mike's is a great, less touristy dive bar in the Central Business District. I say less touristy because the bar was mostly filled with tourists. However, we did get to chatting with a local. Maybe it felt less touristy because it was a really chill pub atmosphere. At least in the middle of a Thursday afternoon. The server was so nice. He answered our questions about beer and even asked us what type of music we wanted to listen to. I forget our response, but Spice Girls Wannabe played first. Per the server's recommendation, I went with the Southern Drawl by Great Raft Brewing. I'm not a lager person, but this was a nice one. It was local and ended up being super cheap. Keeping on the...

Came to NOLA with some friends and they knew someone that worked here. Not a bad dive bar at all. It may not be my favorite place in New Orleans, but I could definitely see myself heading back. They have an adequately sized menu with po-boys, gumbo, and other standard Louisiana fare. I ordered the shrimp po-boy and my friend ordered the couchon de lait po-boy. They were both excellent. The staff was extremely friendly, and I will definitely stop by for drink here again if I'm in the area.

Thank you for serving food in the evening! Excellent shrimp and the gumbo is amazing. Finished work and wanted a quick dinner before bed. I knew the French Quarter would be jumping and didn't want any wait. So I crossed Canal and started looking for a place to eat. Cajun Mike's is a neighborhood bar with plenty to offer. The place is so small, the bartender did all the front end work. She welcomed everyone and filled orders promptly. Clearly a favorite with the neighborhood, she greeted regulars by name. Beer, gumbo and shrimp basket, I couldn't have done better that evening.
